narr: Thunderstorms developed along a cold front and moved slowly through South-Central Texas. The slow movement of storms led to locally heavy rain that resulted in isolated flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. New Berlin Rd. was flooded at Woman Hollering Creek in St. Hedwig.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Ullrich Rd. was flooded at Cibolo Creek in Zuehl.
